basic_details.job_title: JUT Ranchi Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 9 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Jharkhand University of Technology (JUT), Ranchi is engaging 09 Graduate Apprentices under NATS – 2026 for one year at a monthly stipend of Rs. 16650/-. B.Tech. / B.E / BCA / B.Sc. (IT) graduates from any recognized University/College of Jharkhand State who passed during 2022 to 2026 can apply online on the dhteapprenticeship.jharkhand.gov.in portal from 17 November 2026 to 12 December 2026.

salary_details.details: Each Graduate Apprentice gets a monthly stipend of Rs. 16650/-. JUT is responsible only for payment of its own share of the stipend and bears no responsibility for payment of the BoPT (Board of Practical Training) share of the monthly stipend. | The engagement is valid for one (01) year only, counted from the date of generation of the Apprenticeship Contract. On successful completion of one year of apprenticeship training, the Board of Practical Training, Eastern Region awards a Certificate of Proficiency (CoP). The engagement is purely temporary and gives no right or claim to regular appointment in any post of JUT.

content_sections.heading: JUT Graduate Apprentices Quick Facts
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Graduate Apprentices at Various Administrative / Labs / PMU Sections
B.Tech. / B.E / BCA / B.Sc. (IT) from a Jharkhand State University/College, passed 2022 to 2026

content_sections.heading: About JUT
content_sections.text: Jharkhand University of Technology is located at its Science and Technology Campus, Sirkha Toli, Namkum, Ranchi- 834010 (Jharkhand). The university is engaging these apprentices under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended), against vacant seats under NATS – 2026. The apprentices will work in the university's various Administrative, Lab and PMU Sections.

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: All 09 seats are for the position listed as "Various Admin. / Labs / PMU Sections".

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who have passed B.Tech. / B.E / BCA / B.Sc. (IT) from any recognized University/College of Jharkhand State during the years 2022 to 2026 are eligible to apply. A degree from a University/College outside Jharkhand State, or one passed outside the 2022 to 2026 window, does not meet this condition as printed. Shortlisting is based on the aggregate percentage of all subjects of the undergraduate degree. When a percentage is not available, the CGPA conversion certificate issued by the University/Higher Education Institution must be uploaded in the application form. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Graduate Apprentice position.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Each Graduate Apprentice gets a monthly stipend of Rs. 16650/- . JUT is responsible only for payment of its own share of the stipend and bears no responsibility for payment of the BoPT (Board of Practical Training) share of the monthly stipend. The engagement is valid for one (01) year only, counted from the date of generation of the Apprenticeship Contract. On successful completion of one year of apprenticeship training, the Board of Practical Training, Eastern Region awards a Certificate of Proficiency (CoP). The engagement is purely temporary and gives no right or claim to regular appointment in any post of JUT.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JUT Graduate Apprentices
content_sections.text: Open the online application link given in the notice: https://dhteapprenticeship.jharkhand.gov.in/register . Submit the online application between 17 November 2026 and 12 December 2026. If your degree marks are in CGPA and no percentage is available, upload the CGPA conversion certificate issued by your University/Higher Education Institution in the application form. Alternatively, apply online by scanning the QR Code that the notice mentions. CGPA conversion certificate from the University/Higher Education Institution (upload with the application, only when percentage is not available) All original certificates (to be produced by shortlisted candidates at the personal interview)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: shortlisting on degree marks, followed by a Personal Interview. The final selection list combines both. Candidates will be shortlisted on the aggregate percentage obtained in all subjects of the Undergraduate Degree, in the ratio of 1:5 for the total available posts. The list of shortlisted applicants is scheduled for 21 December 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Personal Interview on 28 December 2026 at a place to be communicated in due course of time. The interview carries a maximum of 100 marks. Shortlisted candidates must produce all their original certificates at the interview. The final selection is based on a cumulative score combining the percentage of marks in the qualifying examination and the Personal Interview in the ratio of 70:30 respectively. The final selection list is scheduled for 30 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many Graduate Apprentice seats are in JUT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 09 vacant seats (out of 14 total seats): UR 04, ST 02, SC 01, BC-I 00, BC-II 01 and EWS 01.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JUT Graduate Apprentices?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 12 December 2026; applications started on 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the JUT Graduate Apprentice post?
faq.answer: B.Tech. / B.E / BCA / B.Sc. (IT) from any recognized University/College of Jharkhand State, passed during the years 2022 to 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for JUT Graduate Apprentices?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs. 16650/-. JUT pays only its own share and is not responsible for the BoPT share of the monthly stipend.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the JUT Graduate Apprentices?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://dhteapprenticeship.jharkhand.gov.in/register, or by scanning the QR Code mentioned in the notice, by 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How will JUT select the Graduate Apprentices?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted in the ratio of 1:5 on their aggregate degree percentage, then interviewed; the final score weighs the qualifying examination percentage and the 100-mark interview in the ratio 70:30.

faq.question: Q7. When is the JUT Graduate Apprentice interview?
faq.answer: The Personal Interview is scheduled for 28 December 2026, at a place to be communicated later; the shortlist is due on 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the JUT Graduate Apprentice engagement a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary, valid for one year from the date of generation of the Apprenticeship Contract, and gives no claim to regular appointment in any post of JUT.

faq.question: Q9. What certificate do JUT apprentices get after training?
faq.answer: On successful completion of one year of apprenticeship training, the Board of Practical Training, Eastern Region awards a Certificate of Proficiency (CoP).
